name: Passionstruck
summary:
In a prosperous country known as the Isles, its people live under a blessing and a curse. While every citizen possesses a PASSION, a magical power or talent of one's truest soul, every passion comes with its PARADOX; an unfortunate detriment that cancels out one's gift. As the people's hope for peace runs dry, a group of heroes decides to take on the challenge and break the curse.

As Ilo, a mysterious, magical poet, you and your companion friends go and… take a break from saving the world?? However, what seems like a lovely day out at a local orchard turns into an upbeat adventure full of friendly competition and sprightly fighting.

In Passionstruck, a story-heavy fantasy RPG, engage in fun dialogue, challenge foes in turn-based battles, and explore an unfamiliar, colorful world where its history is for you to discover.
